title: Habitat Failure Scenario Generator: Concept Specification
description: Habitat Failure Scenario Generator — Concept Specification. Creates test cases for life-support faults, power loss, equipment breakdowns, and resource shortages.
body: The Habitat Failure Scenario Generator (catalog entry 717, Space and Civilization Generators) is a proposed Signature-original capability for the JAH Network apex simulator-generator family. Creates test cases for life-support faults, power loss, equipment breakdowns, and resource shortages. This concept specification states the problem it solves, the class of inputs it accepts, and the class of outputs it promises. It is designed to live in the Signature ecosystem alongside the other apex tools: it exchanges tool definitions, simulation results, and evidence packs through the shared apex registry, and every artifact it produces is expected to carry its provenance, tests, and recorded results with it. This record describes a PROPOSED capability, not a completed product. Nothing here claims the tool has been built, independently verified, or deployed. Design rule: a generated tool is NOT marked operational until it has a defined interface, a successful build, meaningful tests, and recorded results.
